summary.title: Top Resources for Startup Marketing and PR
summary.one_liner: A curated Google Sheets list of about 20 links to startup marketing, SEO, media coverage, growth hacking and blogging guides, each with the curator's short comment.
takeaways: Find links to guides on startup SEO, link building and getting media coverage
See B2B and SaaS-specific growth and distribution tactics
Discover blogging and content marketing advice, including a HubSpot video on blogging barriers
Locate a few well-regarded startup presentations and reading for non-technical co-founders
summary.summary: This is a Google Sheets spreadsheet, part of a larger list by Patrick Keane, that collects roughly 20 external resources on startup marketing and PR. Each row gives the title, author, link and a short comment on why it is useful. Topics include SEO (Patrick McKenzie's and Neil Patel's guides), media coverage, link building, B2B growth hacking, SaaS distribution tactics, blogging, and marketing advice from founders like Balsamiq, Mint and Buffer. The sheet itself contains no tutorial content; it is an annotated index that points to other pages.
